query:
SELECT 
  MONTH(createdAt) as mes,
  COUNT(*) as total_vendas,
  SUM(finalAmount) as total_valor
FROM sales 
WHERE YEAR(createdAt) = 2025
GROUP BY MONTH(createdAt)
ORDER BY mes DESC;
